allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://rdap.nic.co/domain/codingcorgi.co" -TimeoutSec 20; $r.entities | Where-Object { $_.roles -contains "registrar" } | ForEach-Object { "Registrar: " + $_.vcardArray[1][1][3] }; "Status: " + \($r.status -join ', '\); "Name servers from RDAP: " + \(\($r.nameservers | ForEach-Object { $_.ldhName }\) -join ', '\) } catch { "RDAP failed: " + $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://rdap.org/domain/codingcorgi.co" -TimeoutSec 25; $r.entities | Where-Object { $_.roles -contains "registrar" } | ForEach-Object { "Registrar: " + $_.vcardArray[1][1][3] }; "Status: " + \($r.status -join ', '\); "NS from RDAP: " + \(\($r.nameservers | ForEach-Object { $_.ldhName }\) -join ', '\) } catch { "RDAP failed: " + $_.Exception.Message })
